title: Tax break for Gowanus Green affordable housing, Brooklyn
summary: This resolution grants a property tax exemption for the Gowanus Green A affordable housing project on Block 471, Lot 1 in Brooklyn, under state law for housing development fund companies. The exemption can last up to 40 years and requires the project to remain income-restricted and compliant with a regulatory agreement with the City. It would terminate early if the property is not operated as required or if ownership changes without city approval.
